methods: independent organization×patent Exp(1) product multiplier sensitivity
mean_denominator: sum origin-organization weight × patent weight × complete-pool exposure 1/pool_n for included fixed situations
ratio_denominator: sum origin-organization weight × patent weight × introduced-document-event indicator; numerator includes both entering and removed signed links
fixed_binding_groups: Origin-known B(C) unfamiliar counts and fixed list exchange only; no outcome-selected subgroup
ratio_zero_draws: Excluded only when bootstrap introduced-event denominator is zero; finite counts retained
ranges: Crossed ranges are fixed-list dependence sensitivities, not validated exact nominal confidence intervals; no causal or new-sample claim
ratio_interpretation: Signed net-yield ratio, not probability. Crossed weights differ for introduced and removed patent identities, so sensitivity endpoints may exceed -1 or 1.
